name: headless-media-ecosystem
description: Framework-agnostic media SDK, platform adapters, headless UI libraries, and demo app.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @headless-media/core && npm run build -w @headless-media/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @headless-media/core && npm run dev -w @headless-media/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:boundaries && npm test && npm run build
